claim: A walkable ramp can pass through a room-over-room plane, so a passage goes down without stairs: the upper half is one flat sector with floor 504 entered over one edge; the lower is one sector of the same plan with ceiling 504 whose floor slopes the whole length, from just under the plane to a step over the room below. CheckLink carries a body across as its middle passes the plane, both ways, so it is walked down and up.
evidence: E2M1 s2 (floor 504, 1,024 x 2,560) and s20 (ceiling 504, floor heinum -2,752), catalog record
warp.cpp CheckLink; built and walked in Gravesend 2026-11-25
E2M1 s2 (floor 504 at 8,192) over s20 (ceiling 504, floor 15 sloped heinum -2,752, 34 degrees), checked 2026-11-26; E4M4 s159 under s154 for a shaft whose top is a linked floor
use: Use it to put a cellar or crypt somewhere the building above does not stand; keep each half one sector (no light cuts) with no other 504 in view of it; whatever is carried stays on its own side of the plane.
